intro: From 14 articles published between April 22 and June 26, 2026, ZCyberNews coverage of Unit 42 highlights 11 high-severity and one critical incident. Key threat actors observed include CL-STA-1062, Gremlin Stealer, and LockBit. The technology, enterprise, software development, energy, and financial services sectors were most affected, with reported impacts spanning Global, Central America, North America, South America, and Southeast Asia.
